answer: An operator running 279 keys as a result pays for 279 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the spiral quota and the terrace admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the vertex ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 11 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
